name: Cube
description: Sealed-tick Fewest-Moves Challenge (FMC). Both players receive the SAME scramble at the start and work the puzzle on their own private cube. Each round both players submit ONE move sealed (R, U', F2, etc. — standard Singmaster notation); reveals happen simultaneously and each move applies only to that player's cube. The first player to reach the solved state wins the game. If both solve the same round, the tie breaks to the player with fewer total moves used. If the move cap is hit before either solves, fewer moves so far wins (true tie possible). Configurable cube size (2×2 or 3×3) and scramble depth.

phases.name: play
phases.description: Both players submit one cube move per round. Round resolves when both have submitted.

entity_types.name: RubiksCubePlayer
entity_types.description: A Rubik's Cube FMC player. Sees their own current cube state (unfolded 6-face view), their move count, and the opponent's move count. Picks ONE legal move per round (R, U', F2 …) or `give_up` if stuck.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Seat: 'white' (first-listed) or 'black' (second). Both players race the same scramble; no in-game color matters.

properties.name: moves_used
properties.description: Total moves this player has applied to their cube.

properties.name: solved
properties.description: True once this player's cube reaches the solved state.

properties.name: algorithm_recall
properties.description: 0 = improvises moves; 1 = aggressively pattern-matches against memorized algorithms (CFOP, OLL/PLL).

properties.name: intuition
properties.description: 0 = relies entirely on memorized algorithms; 1 = looks for opportunistic local improvements outside known algs.

actions.name: cube_move
actions.description: Apply ONE move to your own cube. REQUIRED parameter `move` — a single move in Singmaster notation. Face letters: R (right), L (left), U (up), D (down), F (front), B (back). Modifiers: a single quote ' for counter-clockwise (e.g. R'), the digit 2 for a 180° double turn (e.g. R2). Examples: R, R', R2, U, U', U2, F, F', F2, B, B', B2, L, L', L2, D, D', D2. Each move costs 1 from your move budget. After your move, the engine checks if your cube is solved.

parameters.name: move
parameters.description: Singmaster move notation: one face letter + optional ' or 2 modifier.

actions.name: give_up
actions.description: Concede this game — your cube is declared unsolvable from your current position. Only use this if you are deeply stuck and the opponent has a clear lead. The opponent automatically wins this game.

agent_archetypes.name: CFOP Recaller
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays the canonical Cross → F2L → OLL → PLL method. Strong opening (cross is well-defined) but often misapplies OLL/PLL algorithms when the orientation isn't exact. Move-count: average; consistency: high in early game.

agent_archetypes.name: Layer-By-Layer Beginner
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Knows the beginner-method algorithms (white cross, white corners, middle edges, yellow cross, yellow corners). Slow but reliable on simple scrambles. Falls apart on parity-style positions.

agent_archetypes.name: Intuitive Solver
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays mostly from local pattern-matching — finds pieces, makes setup moves, inserts. Doesn't lean on memorized algs. Lower move-count when it works, prone to errors when blocked.

agent_archetypes.name: Balanced Solver
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Mix of algorithm recall + local intuition. Uses standard algs when the pattern is recognized, falls back to setup-and-insert when not.

agent_archetypes.name: Flailer
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Limited algorithm knowledge, weak spatial reasoning. Often applies moves that undo previous progress. High variance — occasional lucky completions, mostly noise.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Players
runtime_parameters.description: Rubik's Cube Duel is strictly 2 players.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.cube_size
runtime_parameters.label: Cube size
runtime_parameters.description: 2 = 2×2 pocket cube (small state space, often solvable), 3 = 3×3 classic.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.scramble_depth
runtime_parameters.label: Scramble depth (moves)
runtime_parameters.description: Number of random moves applied to scramble the starting position. Higher = harder puzzle.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.move_cap
runtime_parameters.label: Move cap per player
runtime_parameters.description: Maximum moves each player can use. Hitting the cap without solving means tie-break by fewer moves used.

termination_conditions.name: match_won
termination_conditions.description: End the match when a player wins (solves first, or wins on move-cap tie-break).

termination_conditions.name: match_tied
termination_conditions.description: End on a tie (rare — both hit move cap with equal counts).
